yfu-latvia-germany-scholarship-2027-28.about:
YFU Latvia's scholarship competition sends one Latvian student for the 2027-28 school year to a German secondary school with a German host family. The scholarship covers 50%, leaving a co-payment of 3,850 euros for a package that includes host-family housing, preparation materials, seminars before and during the year, YFU support, return flights Latvia-Germany-Latvia and medical, travel and liability insurance.

Selection looks at school grades, German, Latvian and English, extracurricular activities and adaptability. Apply online by 1 December 2026 and email your 2025/26 transcript and motivation letter (subject 'Stipendiju konkurss - Vācija') to info@yfu.lv. First-round results by 8 December; final interviews in mid-January 2027. YFU Latvia also offers year, semester, trimester and summer programmes in about 35 countries.
highlights: 50% scholarship for a school year in Germany
yfu-latvia-germany-scholarship-2027-28.eligibility: Students in Latvia aged 14-17 at application; at least 15 and under 18 at the August 2027 start.
how_to_apply: Fill in the application at yfu.lv (Mācies ārzemēs) selecting 'Stipendiju konkurss - Vācija' by 1 Dec 2026
Email transcript PDF and motivation letter to info@yfu.lv
Second round invitation by 8 Dec 2026
Final interview in January 2027
yfu-latvia-germany-scholarship-2027-28.costs: 50% scholarship; family pays 3,850 euros (flights, insurance, host family, seminars included).

yfu-mongolia-exchange-2027-28.about:
YFU Mongolia sends Mongolian secondary students on exchange semesters and years with host families abroad, including Germany and the USA. Scholarships of 30-100% help students facing financial barriers; past Mongolian students received full scholarships (e.g. six months in the USA), and a PASCH picture contest run with YFU Germany and the Goethe-Institut has awarded discounted or fully funded years in Germany to students of PASCH schools.

Register online (yfu.mn/burtgel.html) and contact the office (+976 86008800) for 2027-28 dates and scholarship rounds.
highlights: Exchange years in Germany, the USA and more
yfu-mongolia-exchange-2027-28.eligibility: Secondary-school students in Mongolia; PASCH contest only for PASCH member schools.
how_to_apply: Read the student exchange page on yfu.mn
Register at yfu.mn/burtgel.html
Ask about scholarships (yfu.mn/tetgeleg.html)
Interview and preparation
yfu-mongolia-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme fee; scholarships of 30-100% for students with financial need or contest winners.

yfu-netherlands-high-school-2027-28.about:
YFU Nederland offers High School Year, Semester, Trimester and Short programmes for ages 14-19 in more than 40 countries on six continents - from Canada, Mexico and the USA to Argentina, Brazil, Japan, India, Vietnam, South Africa and much of Europe - with several departure dates per year (including January and August).

Students live with a volunteer host family and attend a local school. Registration is open; YFU runs information sessions and personal advice calls, and lists promotions and discounts on its site.
how_to_apply: Attend an information session or book an advice call
Choose programme length and country
Register at yfu.nl/inschrijven
Interview and preparation
yfu-netherlands-high-school-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per country; promotions and discounts listed on yfu.nl.

yfu-norway-sweden-exchange-2027-28.about:
YFU Norway offers school years and semesters with volunteer host families in India, Japan, China, Korea, South Africa, Thailand, Vietnam, 18 European countries, seven Latin American countries, Canada, the USA, Australia and New Zealand. YFU Sweden currently routes its 2027-28 applications through YFU Norway.

Applications for 2027-28 are open now and places are given first come, first served; if your first choice is full you can join a waiting list for the next year. Norwegian students can get Lånekassen support for an exchange during VG2 (with exceptions for southern-hemisphere school years). YFU also offers discounts and a payment plan.
highlights: About 35 destinations incl. Vietnam, India, Korea
yfu-norway-sweden-exchange-2027-28.eligibility: Students in Norway or Sweden aged about 14-18.
how_to_apply: Browse destinations on utvekslingselev.yfu.no
Apply at utvekslingselev.yfu.no/sok-na
Attend an info meeting and interview
Apply to Lånekassen (Norway) for VG2 support
yfu-norway-sweden-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per destination; discounts and payment plan; Lånekassen grant for Norwegian students.

yfu-switzerland-exchange-2027.about:
YFU Switzerland offers high-school exchanges in more than 30 countries. Examples for 2027: Ireland (year or semester from January or August 2027, ages 14-18, CHF 15,700-18,900), France (August 2027, ages 14-17, CHF 9,800-11,900) and Argentina (sport-themed year, August 2027, ages 15-17, CHF 12,600-13,600).

Applications for 2027 are open; online information evenings take place on 4 November, 16 November and 2 December 2026. Scholarships are listed at austausch.yfu.ch/stipendien.
how_to_apply: Join an online info evening (4 Nov, 16 Nov or 2 Dec 2026)
Choose a country on austausch.yfu.ch
Apply at austausch.yfu.ch/anmeldung
Ask about scholarships (austausch.yfu.ch/stipendien)
yfu-switzerland-exchange-2027.costs: Examples: CHF 9,800-18,900 depending on country and length; scholarships available.

yfu-uruguay-exchange-2027-28.about:
YFU Uruguay sends Uruguayan secondary students on exchanges with volunteer host families; students choose the destination country and length of stay. Programme costs can be paid in interest-free instalments, and YFU offers scholarships (you may apply for only one).

Contact info@yfu.org.uy for the 2027-28 schedule and scholarship process.
yfu-uruguay-exchange-2027-28.eligibility: Secondary-school students in Uruguay (age by destination).
how_to_apply: See programmes and prices on estudiantes.yfu.org.uy
Request information or apply via the 'Aplicar' page
Email info@yfu.org.uy about scholarships
Interview and preparation
yfu-uruguay-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme price per destination, interest-free instalments; one scholarship per applicant.

ymun-latin-america-2027.about:
YMUN Latin America is Yale Model UN's regional conference in Mexico City, staffed by Yale students and run with YMUN's rules, awards and committee policies.

The conference runs 21–23 May 2027 at Mexico City, Mexico. It is open to high school students and school delegations from Latin America and beyond. Working language: English.

Register through the 'Register' page; visa information and hotel guides are on the official site. The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
highlights: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page
ymun-latin-america-2027.eligibility: Open to high school students and school delegations from Latin America and beyond. Working language: English. No nationality restrictions are stated; international delegates (including from Georgia and Qatar) can apply, arranging their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open the official website (link below) and read the conference information and committee list.
Register through the 'Register' page; visa information and hotel guides are on the official site.
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
ymun-latin-america-2027.costs: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

ymun-singapore-iv-2027.about:
Yale Model United Nations Singapore (YMUNS) is run by Yale students and is Yale's only Model UN conference in Southeast Asia. YMUNS IV takes place on 12–14 March 2027 in Singapore, with committees ranging from regional to global issues, pre-conference programming, topic guides and position-paper awards.

It is aimed at high-school students; schools and individual delegates register online and can apply for financial aid. Country assignments are released on a rolling basis in January–February 2027.

A high-quality, Yale-run conference that is easy to reach from across Asia.
ymun-singapore-iv-2027.eligibility: High-school students worldwide, as school delegations or individuals. English is the working language.
how_to_apply: Read Registration on ymuns.org
Register and pay through the official form
Apply for financial aid by 20 Jan 2027 if needed
Receive your country assignment and submit a position paper
ymun-singapore-iv-2027.costs: Fees differ for early and regular registration (shown on the official registration form); financial aid is available. Travel and accommodation extra.

ymun-south-asia-ii-2026.about:
Yale Model United Nations South Asia (YMUNSA), founded in 2014, is run by Yale undergraduates together with local partners. YMUNSA II takes place on 27–29 November 2026 at Harrow International School in Bengaluru, India, with general assemblies, specialised and crisis committees, topic guides and a sample topic guide online, plus an essay competition.

Delegations of any size and individual delegates can register through the official registration platform; places are filled on a rolling basis and country preferences are honoured in order of payment. Financial aid is available.

A rare chance to experience Yale-run committees in South Asia; register soon because places are allocated first come, first served.
highlights: Rolling admission, preferences by payment order
ymun-south-asia-ii-2026.eligibility: High-school students (delegations or individuals) from India and abroad. English is the working language.
how_to_apply: Read Registration Info on ymunsouthasia.org
Register through the official registration link
Pay the delegate fee to secure your place
Prepare with the topic guides and attend 27–29 November 2026
ymun-south-asia-ii-2026.costs: Delegate fee USD 150 early / USD 170 regular / USD 190 late; advisor fee USD 60 (official registration page). Travel and accommodation extra; financial aid available.

ymun-taiwan-xiii-2027.about:
Yale Model United Nations Taiwan (YMUNT) has brought delegates from Taiwan and the Asia-Pacific together for over a decade. YMUNT XIII runs on 12–14 March 2027 in Taipei, with general assemblies, regional bodies, specialised agencies and crisis committees chaired by Yale undergraduates, plus admissions panels, speakers and social events.

Delegations of any size and individual delegates aged 13+ can register on the official platform. Early registrants receive preferential country and committee assignments; there is a delegate training programme and an Assured YMUNT Scholarship as well as financial aid.

A well-organised Yale conference with transparent fees and scholarships, easily reachable from across East and Southeast Asia.
ymun-taiwan-xiii-2027.eligibility: Students aged 13+ (high school), as school delegations or individual delegates, from Taiwan and abroad. English is the working language.
how_to_apply: Read Registration Information on ymunt.org
Create an account on the registration platform and submit delegation size
Pay early (by 1 Dec 2026) or regular fees (by 15 Jan 2027); apply for scholarship by 15 Dec
Submit forms, delegate names and position papers, then attend 12–14 March 2027
ymun-taiwan-xiii-2027.costs: Early registration USD 165 per delegate and USD 35 per advisor (by 1 Dec 2026); regular USD 195 per delegate and USD 50 per advisor. Travel and accommodation extra; scholarships and financial aid available.

yonsei-international-summer-school-2027.about:
Yonsei International Summer School (YISS) is Korea's biggest and oldest international summer programme. In 2027 it runs a 6-week session (28 June – 4 August) and a 4-week session (28 June – 22 July) on Yonsei's central Seoul campus, with over 100 English-taught credit courses in seven academic fields (Korean studies, business, social sciences, humanities, sciences and more), Korean language classes, field trips and cultural activities.

It suits university students who want transferable credits and a summer in Seoul; high-school seniors already admitted to a university abroad can also join. Tuition in 2026 was KRW 2,020,000 for one course (10% early-bird discount), and fee-paying students can apply for the need-based Kim Suk-Hi and Do-Sim Scholarship (KRW 1,000,000 tuition + KRW 900,000 housing support).
highlights: 100+ English-taught credit courses in seven fields
Central Seoul campus with cultural trips and Korean language options
Early-bird discount and need-based tuition/housing scholarships
yonsei-international-summer-school-2027.eligibility: Students currently studying at, or admitted to, a university or college outside Korea (minimum cumulative GPA 2.0/4.0); master's and doctoral students also eligible. High-school seniors need an official admission letter from a university. Open to all nationalities.
how_to_apply: Check the YISS Application Procedures page for 2027 early-bird and general deadlines
Prepare an official English transcript (or admission letter/certificate of enrolment) and passport copy
Apply through the YISS Online Application System and pay the KRW 100,000 application fee
After admission, apply for scholarships in the same system (same deadline as YISS)
Pay tuition by the stated deadline to secure your place
yonsei-international-summer-school-2027.costs: 2026 fees: application KRW 100,000; tuition KRW 2,020,000 (1 course), 3,630,000 (2) or 4,130,000 (3), about 10% less with early bird. Housing optional and extra. Need-based scholarship of up to KRW 1,000,000 tuition + KRW 900,000 housing.
